info.name: Mend Access Management User Management - Roles And Permissions API

params.name: projectToken
params.description: project UUID (by running Entities - Product > Get Product Projects) or Project Token (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **Project Token**).

items.docs: Returns the actions permitted actions to the current user in a given project

params.name: productToken
params.description: product UUID (by running Entities - Organization > Get Organization Products) or Product Token (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **Product Token**).

items.docs: This api returns the list of permitted actions for the logged-in user and the a given product

params.name: orgToken
params.description: org UUID (by running Entities - Organization > Get User Organizations) or API Key (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **API Key**).

items.docs: This api returns the listed of permitted actions for the logged-in user and the given organization
